_comment: W3 — hand-authored TSDoc overlay for event classes that LiquidBounce's source does not (yet) document. Applied by post-patches.sh via a SECOND apply-kdoc.py pass, AFTER the extracted manifest. apply-kdoc skips any class that already has a doc block, so genuine upstream KDoc always wins and these only fill gaps (an entry self-retires once LB documents that class). Descriptions are derived from each event's class name, @Tag and constructor signature in references/liquidbounce; `source` is intentionally omitted so no version-specific permalink drifts. Schema is the v2 kdoc manifest (tools/kdoc-extractor/manifest.schema.json).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ga.doc: Fires on every client game tick (the main ~20 TPS client loop). The most common hook for periodic per-tick logic.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pl.doc: Fires each client player tick, before movement is processed. Cancellable — cancelling skips the player's tick.
Fires each client player tick, after movement has been processed.
Fires during the player's movement-tick phase, as movement is applied.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ke.doc: A raw keyboard key press or release, reported with the key and GLFW action code.
A keyboard key event carrying the key, key/scan codes, GLFW action, modifier flags and the active screen (if any).
A translated character (Unicode code point) input event, e.g. for typing into text fields.
Fires when the client's keybind configuration changes.
Reports whether a given key binding is currently pressed, exposing the key binding and the pressed state.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Mo.doc: A mouse button press or release, with the button, GLFW action, modifier flags and the active screen (if any).
A mouse wheel scroll, reported as horizontal and vertical deltas.
A mouse scroll routed to hotbar slot selection, exposing the scroll speed. Cancellable.
The current mouse cursor position, exposing its x and y coordinates.
Camera rotation derived from raw mouse-movement deltas. Cancellable — cancelling suppresses the look rotation.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wi.doc: Fires when the game window is resized, exposing the new width and height.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Fr.doc: Fires when the render framebuffer is resized, exposing the new width and height.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pl.doc: Fires as the player's motion is applied, exposing the mover type and the (mutable) movement vector, so handlers can alter movement.
Fires when the player initiates a jump, exposing the (mutable) jump motion and yaw. Cancellable — cancelling prevents the jump.
Fires immediately after a jump's motion has been applied.
Fires around the movement-packet sync (PRE/POST phase), exposing the position and on-ground flag reported to the server. Cancellable.
Fires when the player is being pushed out of a block collision. Cancellable.
Fires during strafe velocity calculation, exposing the movement input, speed, yaw and the resulting velocity.
Fires when the player's auto-step height is calculated, exposing the step height.
Fires after a successful step-up, exposing the attempted and adjusted movement vectors.
Fires to determine whether safe-walk (ledge edge protection) is active.
Fires during stride-force adjustment, exposing the stride force.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Mo.doc: Exposes the player's per-tick movement input (directional input plus the jump and sneak flags).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.At.doc: Fires when the player attacks an entity, exposing the target entity. Cancellable — cancelling prevents the attack.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pl.doc: Fires after an item interaction completes, exposing the hand used and the interaction result.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ta.doc: Fires to classify an entity for targeting (target / friend / ignored, etc.), exposing the entity and its mutable targeting info.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pa.doc: Fires for every packet sent or received, exposing the transfer origin and the packet. Cancellable — cancelling drops the packet.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Bl.doc: Fires when a packet is queued or released by the Blink module, exposing the packet and its transfer origin.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pi.doc: Fires when a network channel pipeline is initialized, exposing the pipeline and whether the connection is local.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ti.doc: Fires during the packet-processing phase of the client tick.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wo.doc: Fires when the client world is loaded or unloaded; the world is null when leaving a world.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ch.doc: Fires when a chunk is loaded, exposing its chunk coordinates.
Fires when a chunk is unloaded, exposing its chunk position.
Fires when multiple blocks in a chunk section change at once (a batched section-blocks-update packet).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Bl.doc: Fires when a block changes, exposing the position and the new block state.
Fires when the player starts breaking a block, exposing its position. Cancellable.
Fires when a block's collision shape is queried, exposing the block state, position and voxel shape.
Fires as block-breaking progresses, exposing the target block position.
Fires to determine a block's velocity multiplier (e.g. soul sand, honey), exposing the block and the multiplier.
Fires to determine a block's slipperiness/friction multiplier (e.g. ice), exposing the block and the multiplier.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wo.doc: Fires when an entity is removed from the world, exposing the entity and the removal reason.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ga.doc: Fires at the start of the main render frame.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wo.doc: Fires while the world is rendered, exposing the pose stack, camera and partial-tick fraction — for depth-correct 3D rendering.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ov.doc: Fires while the in-game overlay/HUD is rendered (after the world, before screens), exposing the draw context and tick delta.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Sc.doc: Fires while the current GUI screen is rendered (the topmost layer), exposing the draw context and partial-tick fraction.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ch.doc: Fires when the player sends a chat message, exposing the message text. Cancellable — cancelling stops the message from being sent.
Fires when a chat or system message is received, exposing the raw message string and its component form. Cancellable — cancelling hides the message.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Sc.doc: Fires when a GUI screen is opened or closed, exposing the screen (null when closing). Cancellable.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Mo.doc: Fires when a module is enabled or disabled, exposing the module name and its new enabled state.
Fires when a module is activated, exposing the module name.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.No.doc: Fires when the client shows a notification, exposing its title, message and severity.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.He.doc: Fires when the player's health, hunger or saturation changes, exposing the new and previous values.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.De.doc: Fires when the local player dies.
